confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of Krakow price levels, without inspecting live menus, booking pages or listings. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately reliable. Hostel and hotel anchors are less certain because July is peak season and rates vary widely. Cocktail and wine_glass are estimated from the local beer and restaurant price relationship, since direct knowledge is weaker. FX provenance: the 2026-10-15 AUD/USD 0.6955 figure came from search-result summaries that attribute it to the RBA exchange rates page. I did not open the RBA page directly, and I did not use a third-party 16 October figure.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on the price level of comparable Central and Eastern European mid-sized cities with strong summer tourism demand, such as Wroclaw, Gdansk and Prague's lower-cost districts, adjusted for Krakow's Old Town premium in July.
